method: stratified task-cluster bootstrap, shared draws across every statistic
clustering: resampling unit is (dataset, source_task_id); every scorer x condition row for a resampled task travels together
stratification: independent resampling within each of mtbench/arena_hard/wildbench, drawing the same number of tasks as that stratum contains, every replicate, regardless of which estimand is being computed from it
empty_cell_rule: average over non-empty cells in that replicate; count of affected replicates is reported per estimand (E5)
